### function enhanceRankingLayout(route)
function enhanceRankingLayout(route){
 if(route==='home'||route==='ranking'){
 const center=document.querySelector('.stack.center');
 if(!center)return;
 center.replaceChildren();
 const section=document.createElement('section');section.className='panel fztv-center-ranking';
 section.innerHTML='<div class="head"><h2>РЕЙТИНГ КОМАНД · COUNTER-STRIKE 2</h2><small>FZ POINTS</small></div>';
 const banner=document.createElement('div');banner.innerHTML=fzRankingBanner();section.append(banner.firstElementChild);
 const previous=section.querySelector('#fzPrevWeek'),next=section.querySelector('#fzNextWeek');
 previous.onclick=()=>{rankingWeekOffset--;render()};next.onclick=()=>{rankingWeekOffset=Math.min(0,rankingWeekOffset+1);render()};
 const list=document.createElement('div');list.className='fztv-unified-rank-list';
 const staticTeams=[
 {name:'Team Woods',logo:document.createElement('div'),players:woodsRosterNow().map(p=>({nickname:p[0],photo_url:p[1],slug:p[2],lineup_position:p[3]})),href:'#/team/woods'},
 
 ];
 const original=document.createElement('template');original.innerHTML=ranking();
 const originalRows=[...original.content.querySelectorAll('a.rank-team')];
 staticTeams.forEach((t,i)=>{const source=originalRows.find(row=>row.querySelector('.rank-main strong')?.textContent.trim()===t.name);if(source){const img=source.querySelector('.rank-logo');if(img)t.logo=img.cloneNode(true);}});
 const dynamic=approvedTeamsCache.filter(t=>t.name.trim().toLowerCase()!=='team woods').map(t=>({name:t.name,logo_url:t.logo_url,players:approvedRosterCache[t.id]||[],href:'#/team-created/'+encodeURIComponent(t.id),country:teamNationality(approvedRosterCache[t.id]||[]).flag}));
 const entries=[...staticTeams,...dynamic].sort((a,b)=>getTeamRP(b.name)-getTeamRP(a.name));
 entries.forEach((t,i)=>{
 const orderedPlayers=[...t.players].sort((a,b)=>(a.lineup_position||99)-(b.lineup_position||99));
 const starters=orderedPlayers.filter(p=>Number(p.lineup_position||99)<=5).slice(0,5);
 const reserves=orderedPlayers.filter(p=>!starters.includes(p)).slice(0,5);
 const card=document.createElement('details');card.className='fztv-unified-team';if(i===0){card.open=true;card.classList.add('fztv-first-place');}
 const summary=document.createElement('summary');summary.className='fztv-unified-summary';// First-place team uses native details toggle, just like other teams.
 const rank=document.createElement('b');rank.className='fztv-unified-place';rank.textContent='#'+(i+1);
 const logo=document.createElement('span');logo.className='fztv-unified-logo';
 if(t.logo_url){const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=t.logo_url;img.alt='';logo.append(img);}else if(t.logo)logo.append(t.logo);else logo.textContent='🏆';
 const name=document.createElement('span');name.className='fztv-unified-name';const title=document.createElement('strong');title.textContent=t.name;const sub=document.createElement('small');sub.textContent=starters.length?starters.map(p=>p.nickname).join(' · ')+(reserves.length?' · Запас: '+reserves.length:''):'Состав пока не добавлен';name.append(title,sub);const tierBadge=document.createElement('span');tierBadge.className='fztv-rank-tier-red';tierBadge.textContent='TIER '+(i+1<=10?1:i+1<=20?2:3);name.append(tierBadge);
 const points=document.createElement('b');points.className='fztv-unified-points';points.textContent=getTeamRP(t.name)+' FZ';
 const arrow=document.createElement('span');arrow.className='fztv-unified-arrow';arrow.textContent='⌄';
 summary.append(rank,logo,name,points,arrow);card.append(summary);
 const detail=document.createElement('div');detail.className='fztv-unified-detail';
 const roster=document.createElement('div');roster.className='fztv-unified-roster';
 if(!starters.length){const p=document.createElement('p');p.textContent='Состав команды пока не добавлен';roster.append(p);}
 Array.from({length:5},(_,slot)=>starters[slot]||null).forEach(p=>{const player=document.createElement('div');player.className='fztv-unified-player';if(p?.photo_url){const img=document.createElement('img');img.src=p.photo_url;img.alt='';player.append(img);}else{const empty=document.createElement('span');empty.className='fztv-empty-player';empty.textContent=p?'👤':'?';player.append(empty);}const nick=document.createElement('b');nick.textContent=p?(p.nickname||'Игрок'):'Свободно';player.append(nick);if(!p)player.classList.add('fztv-unified-player-free');roster.append(player);});
 const link=document.createElement('a');link.href=t.href;link.textContent='Профиль команды →';link.className='fztv-unified-profile';
 detail.append(roster);
 if(reserves.length){
  const panel=document.createElement('div');panel.className='fztv-bench-panel';
  const header=document.createElement('div');header.className='fztv-bench-heading';header.textContent='ЗАМЕНА · '+reserves.length+'/5';
  const list=document.createElement('div');list.className='fztv-bench-list';
  reserves.forEach(p=>{
   const item=document.createElement('a');item.className='fztv-bench-player';
   item.href=p.id?'#/player/team_'+p.id.replace(/-/g,''):'#/player/'+encodeURIComponent(p.slug||'');
   if(p.photo_url){const avatar=document.createElement('img');avatar.src=p.photo_url;avatar.alt='';item.append(avatar);}
   const name=document.createElement('span');name.textContent=p.nickname||'Игрок';item.append(name);
   list.append(item);
  });
  panel.append(header,list);detail.append(panel);
 }
 detail.append(link);card.append(detail);list.append(card);
 });
 section.append(list);center.append(section);
 document.querySelectorAll('a[data-route="ranking"],a[href="#/ranking"]').forEach(link=>{if(!link.closest('.fztv-center-ranking'))link.remove();});
 const left=document.querySelector('.stack.left');if(left)[...left.children].filter(x=>x.textContent.includes('РЕЙТИНГ КОМАНД')).forEach(x=>x.remove());
 }
}

### function woodsRosterNow(){
function woodsRosterNow(){return teamWoodsRoster.filter(([name])=>{if(window.fztvRemovedPlayers?.has(name.toLowerCase()))return false;const p=legacyRosterCache.find(x=>x.player_slug===name.toLowerCase());return !p||p.team_name?.toLowerCase()==='team woods';}).map(([name,photo])=>{const p=legacyRosterCache.find(x=>x.player_slug===name.toLowerCase());return [p?.nickname||name,p?.photo_url||photo,name.toLowerCase(),p?.lineup_position||10];}).sort((a,b)=>a[3]-b[3]);}
async function loadLegacyRoster(){const {data,error}=await sb.from('fztv_roster_players').select('player_slug,nickname,photo_url,age,team_name,lineup_position');if(error){console.warn('Woods roster:',error.message);return;}legacyRosterCache=data||[];if(['home','ranking','team','players','player'].includes((location.hash||'#/home').split('/')[1]))render();}
async function loadTeamRP(){const {data,error}=await sb.from('fztv_team_rp').select('name,rp');if(error){console.warn('FZ RP:',error.message);return;}teamRpCache=Object.fromEntries((data||[]).map(x=>[x.name.toLowerCase(),Number(x.rp)||0]));if(['home','ranking','team','team-created'].includes((location.hash||'#/home').split('/')[1]))render();}

let approvedRosterCache={};
const countryFlags={'россия':'🇷🇺','russia':'🇷🇺','ru':'🇷🇺','украина':'🇺🇦','ukraine':'🇺🇦','ua':'🇺🇦','беларусь':'🇧🇾','belarus':'🇧🇾','by':'🇧🇾','казахстан':'🇰🇿','kazakhstan':'🇰🇿','kz':'🇰🇿','швеция':'🇸🇪','sweden':'🇸🇪','se':'🇸🇪','сша':'🇺🇸','usa':'🇺🇸','us':'🇺🇸','польша':'🇵🇱','poland':'🇵🇱','pl':'🇵🇱','германия':'🇩🇪','germany':'🇩🇪','de':'🇩🇪','франция':'🇫🇷','france':'🇫🇷','fr':'🇫🇷','бразилия':'🇧🇷','brazil':'🇧🇷','br':'🇧🇷','дания':'🇩🇰','denmark':'🇩🇰','dk':'🇩🇰','финляндия':'🇫🇮','finland':'🇫🇮','fi':'🇫🇮'};
function teamNationality(players){
 const counts=new Map();
 for(const p of players||[]){const c=String(p.country||'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('ru');if(c)counts.set(c,(counts.get(c)||0)+1);}
 const winner=[...counts].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0];
 return winner&&winner[1]>=4?{country:winner[0],flag:countryFlags[winner[0]]||'🌐',count:winner[1]}:{country:'Международная',flag:'🌐',count:0};
}
async function loadApprovedTeams(){
 const {data,error}=await sb.from('fztv_teams').select('id,name,tag,country,logo_url').eq('status','approved').order('created_at',{ascending:true});
 if(error){console.warn('Approved teams:',error.message);return;}
 approvedTeamsCache=data||[];
 const {data:players, error:playersError}=await sb.from('fztv_team_players').select('id,team_id,nickname,country,photo_url,lineup_position').in('team_id',approvedTeamsCache.map(t=>t.id).length?approvedTeamsCache.map(t=>t.id):['00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000']);
 approvedRosterCache={};
 if(!playersError){for(const p of players||[])(approvedRosterCache[p.team_id]??=[]).push(p);for(const rows of Object.values(approvedRosterCache))rows.sort((a,b)=>(a.lineup_position||99)-(b.lineup_position||99));}
 if(['home','ranking'].includes((location.hash||'#/home').replace(/^#\/?/,'').split('/')[0]))render();
}
function approvedTeamRows(){
 return approvedTeamsCache.filter(t=>t.name.toLowerCase()!=='team woods').map((t,i)=>{
 const players=approvedRosterCache[t.id]||[],nationality=teamNationality(players);
 const roster=players.map(p=>'<div class="fztv-rank-player">'+(p.photo_url?'<img src="'+escapeAuth(p.photo_url)+'" alt="">':'<span class="fztv-player-placeholder">👤</span>')+'<b>'+escapeAuth(p.nickname||'Игрок')+'</b></div>').join('');
 return '<article class="fztv-rank-entry"><div class="fztv-rank-summary"><span class="fztv-rank-position">#'+(i+3)+'</span><div class="fztv-rank-logo">'+(t.logo_url?'<img src="'+escapeAuth(t.logo_url)+'" alt="">':'🏆')+'</div><span class="fztv-rank-country" title="'+escapeAuth(nationality.country)+'">'+nationality.flag+'</span><div class="fztv-rank-name"><strong>'+escapeAuth(t.name)+'</strong><small>'+escapeAuth(t.tag||'CS2')+' · '+(players.length?players.length+' игроков':'Состав не заполнен')+'</small></div><span class="fztv-rank-points">0 <small>FZ Points</small></span><span class="fztv-rank-tier">TIER '+(i+3<=10?1:i+3<=20?2:3)+'</span></div><div class="fztv-rank-expanded"><div class="fztv-rank-roster">'+(roster||'<p>Состав команды пока не добавлен</p>')+'</div><a href="#/team-created/'+encodeURIComponent(t.id)+'">Профиль команды →</a><span>'+nationality.flag+' '+escapeAuth(nationality.country)+(nationality.count?' · '+nationality.count+' игрока одной страны':'')+'</span></div></article>';
 }).join('');
}
function createdTeamDetail(){
 const id=(location.hash.split('/')[2]||'');
 const t=approvedTeamsCache.find(x=>x.id===id);
 if(!t)return '<section class="panel detail-empty">Команда не найдена. <a href="#/ranking">Рейтинг</a></section>';
 return '<div class="crumb"><a href="#/ranking">Рейтинг</a> / '+escapeAuth(t.name)+'</div><section class="panel" style="padding:24px"><h1>'+escapeAuth(t.name)+'</h1>'+(t.logo_url?'<img src="'+escapeAuth(t.logo_url)+'" alt="" width="110" height="110" style="object-fit:cover;border-radius:14px">':'')+'<p>Тег: '+escapeAuth(t.tag||'')+'</p><p>Статус: Одобрена</p><p>Рейтинг: 0</p></section>';
}

function fzWeekStart(offset=0){const d=new Date();d.setHours(12,0,0,0);const day=(d.getDay()+6)%7;d.setDate(d.getDate()-day+offset*7);return d;}
function fzRankingBanner(){

 const dateLabel=date.toLocaleDateString('ru-RU',{day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'});
 return '<div class="fztv-week-banner"><div class="fztv-week-copy"><small>FRAGZONETV · МИРОВОЙ РЕЙТИНГ</small><h2>РЕЙТИНГ КОМАНД COUNTER-STRIKE — '+(current?'СЕЙЧАС':'НЕДЕЛЯ С '+dateLabel.toUpperCase())+'</h2><p>'+(current?'Текущий рейтинг команд':'Выбранная неделя · исторические очки пока не сохранены')+'</p></div><div class="fztv-week-actions"><button type="button" id="fzPrevWeek" aria-label="Предыдущая неделя">‹</button><button type="button" id="fzNextWeek" aria-label="Следующая неделя" '+(current?'disabled':'')+'>›</button></div></div>';
}

function teamNationality(players){
 const counts=new Map();
 for(const p of players||[]){const c=String(p.country||'').trim().toLocaleLowerCase('ru');if(c)counts.set(c,(counts.get(c)||0)+1);}
 const winner=[...counts].sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1])[0];
 return winner&&winner[1]>=4?{country:winner[0],flag:countryFlags[winner[0]]||'🌐',count:winner[1]}:{country:'Международная',flag:'🌐',count:0};
}
